item.title: 半导体量子阱中的电子晶体和准晶体：人工智能驱动的发现
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Filippo Gaggioli, Pierre-Antoine Graham, Liang Fu
均质电子气是量子凝聚态物理学的基石，为发展密度泛函理论和理解半导体中的电子相奠定了基础。然而，对现实半导体系统中强相关电子的理论理解仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于神经网络的变分方法来研究各种电子密度和阱厚度的三维几何中的量子阱。从第一原理开始，我们的无偏人工智能驱动方法揭示了具有单层和双层电荷分布的金属相和结晶相。在出现的双层中，我们发现了一种新的物质量子相：电子准晶体。

item.title: 高熵催化剂的机器学习：方法与应用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hao Chen, Zongrui Pei, Xianglin Liu
高熵合金（HEA）由于其高构型熵、协同元素效应、可调电子结构和优异的结构稳定性，在各种反应中表现出优异的催化性能。然而，HEA 催化剂的巨大组成空间使得传统的实验和理论设计成本高昂且效率低下。近年来，数据驱动的机器学习 (ML) 方法已成为研究催化中 HEA 的强大工具。通过预测模型和机器学习代理，研究人员可以破译这些材料复杂的成分-结构-性能关系。

item.title: SU(2)-分子磁学的等变旋量消息传递
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Erh-Wei Sheng, Beom Seok Kang, Yuchao Lin, Danish Khan, Anima Anandkumar
预测分子磁性通常需要使用自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 进行电子结构计算，而在许多分子中重复计算的成本很高。底层电子态可以转换为旋量，但等变代理通常仅使用整数秩特征。受到这些电子态的旋量性质的启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一种传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递和规范不变读数来进行独立于任意特征基选择的预测。

item.title: A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jingzhou Liu
arXiv:2610.28864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. The frameworks apply to arbitrary network architectures and include methods applicable to degenerate critical orbit…

item.title: SoLiD26：用于机器学习原子间势的第一原理固液界面数据集
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jonas Busk, Emil J. P. Frost, Yogeshwaran Krishnan, Henrik H. Kristoffersen, August E. G. Mikkelsen, Xueping Qin 等10位作者
与传统的从头计算方法相比，机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 能够在更长的时间尺度上模拟更大的原子系统，但需要大量、多样化的训练数据。现有数据集缺乏对固液界面的全面采样，这些界面表现出复杂的现象，例如对于能源和催化材料至关重要的溶剂分层和表面重建。在这里，我们展示了 SoLiD26，这是一个精心策划的固液界面数据集，包含 1540 万个第一性原理结构，最多包含 576 个原子和 15 种化学元素，用于训练和评估 MLIP。

item.title: 用于多模态 X 射线和中子散射反演的组合神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Valentin Munteanu, Alexander Hinderhofer, Dmitry Lapkin, Vladimir Starostin, Frank Schreiber
X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一个基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。

item.title: 使用机器学习和大型语言模型自动提取材料数据和知识
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Aravindan Kamatchi Sundaram, B. Pabitramohan Prusty, Rohit Batra
在过去的十年中，人们致力于开发机器学习 (ML) 方法，以直接从科学文献中提取材料数据（如果可能）和材料知识。本综述追溯了这些方法的演变，从启发式、基于规则的管道，到自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型和基于转换器的编码器，最后到大型语言模型 (LLM) 和能够跨多种模式（包括文本、表格和图形）提取材料信息的代理系统。

item.title: 代理人工智能以图案语言进行晶体结构设计
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dinh-Khiet Le, Minh-Quyet Ha, Hong-Phuc Vu-Dinh, Viet-Cuong Nguyen, Huan Tran, Truyen Tran 等9位作者
数据驱动的材料发现插值比推断更可靠，并且很少揭示新的结构类型。我们提出了 MatEvolve，一个代理 AI 框架，它以可解释的主题语言设计晶体，其中每个晶体都被编写为一个 emphmotif 配置文件，描述了组成晶体的重复几何图案（emphmotif）。主题轮廓不仅可以作为材料的描述，而且可以作为材料设计的媒介：代理以规定的理由编辑轮廓，并根据修改后的轮廓构造出晶体；然后通过第一性原理计算来验证最有希望的候选者。

item.title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Can Erer, H. Birkan Yilmaz, Nebahat Aral
arXiv:2610.28709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at 4×10⁹ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio I(t)/I₀ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construct…

item.title: A machine learning closure for polymer integral equation theory
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Polymer reference interaction site model (PRISM) theory, a descendant of Ornstein–Zernike liquid state theory, is a powerful tool to predict the structure and thermodynamics of equilibrium polymer systems, but its accuracy and applicability can be limited in some important cases. Typically, these shortcomings are traced to the analytical closure relationships used to solve the integral equations. Here, we propose a machine learning (ML)-based closure relation trained on a dataset of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of homopolymer melts and solutions. PRISM theory with the ML closure outperforms traditional atomic closures (e.g., Percus–Yevick) in predicting the structure of typical coarse-grained model systems. We also use the ML closure to accurately model the results of sma…

item.title: From Weather to Enhanced Weathering: Weather Foundation Models for Carbon Dioxide Removal at Operational Scale
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sasankh Munukutla, Felipe Oviedo, Danrong Zhang, Kenji Takeda, Juan M Lavista Ferres
arXiv:2610.28973v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) is a carbon removal solution with the potential to remove gigatons of CO₂ per year, but quantifying that removal today requires dense soil sampling and laboratory analysis. We evaluate five weather Foundation Models (FMs) as frozen encoders feeding lightweight decoders, under a leave-one-field-out protocol on 5,192 chronosequences from 264 fields across Brazil and the US. To our knowledge, this is the first holistic evaluation of weather FMs for ERW and the largest evaluation on operational ERW data. We find that across weather FMs, representations transfer to ERW: our best model, TerraNova-ERW, built on Aurora 1.5, positively orders measurements within fields it has never seen. Zero-shot prediction of a new fi…

item.title: 镁化合物的紧结合与机器学习潜力模型相结合
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiwen Yu, Arash A. Mostofi, Andrew Horsfield
我们提出了一种基于镁的系统模型，该模型将密度泛函紧结合 (DFTB) 与 MACE（一种机器学习原子间势 (DFTB+MACE)）相结合。在此模型中，传统的排斥势、对势被多体 MACE 势所取代。该模型的 MACE 组件根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能量和力之间的差异以及相应的 DFTB 值进行训练，但忽略了对的潜在贡献。使用该模型，我们进行了 MgO-CO2 吸附系统的结构弛豫、水簇的分子动力学计算以及稳定 fcc-MgO 和亚稳态 bcc-MgO 结构的声子谱计算。

item.title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 G. X. A. Petronilo, M. R. Araújo, Erico S. Teixeira, Clebson Cruz
arXiv:2610.29779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular electronic structure using Quantum Computing approaches is a challenge in Computational Chemistry. Traditional Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQEs) are typically hindered by optimization challenges. The alternative Generative Quantum Eigensolver (GQE) mitigates this by reformulating ground-state search as discrete sequence generation, but its Transformer backbone suffers from quadratic computational complexity, bottlenecking scalability for larger molecules. To address this, we introduce the Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (Mamba-QE), which replaces the Transformer with a Selective State Space Model (SSM) to process operator sequences with linear O(L) complexity. Additionally, we integrate a distance-conditioned mechanism e…

item.title: macroqc 2.0: An electronic structure theory software for large-scale applications
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
macroqc is a quantum chemistry software package designed for high-accuracy electronic structure computations and large-scale molecular simulations. The macroqc framework provides efficient implementations of energies and analytic gradients for a wide range of many-body perturbation theory and coupled-cluster (CC) methods. In particular, the analytic gradient implementations of second-order Møller–Plesset perturbation theory (MP2), coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD), and CCSD with perturbative triples [CCSD(T)] exhibit excellent computational performance, even in comparison with established commercial quantum chemistry programs. In addition to conventional correlated methods, macroqc incorporates several advanced capabilities, including molecular fragmentation techniques for ground…

item.title: Introducing Vmol software: A highly parallelized multi-purpose DFT program based on real-space grid formalism
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
We present a review of “Vmol,” a highly parallelized, multi-purpose density functional theory (DFT) software based on a real-space grid formalism. By utilizing higher-order finite difference methods and nonlocal pseudopotentials, “Vmol” serves as a versatile and computationally robust platform for Kohn–Sham DFT calculations. By virtue of the hybrid parallel implementation (message passing interface/OpenMP), it delivers high performance on massively parallel computers integrating many processors. In the development of these several decades, “Vmol” offered marked adaptability as an electronic structure program to various extensions, such as the hybrid Quantum Mechanical (QM)/Molecular Mechanical (MM) approach and its combination with a theory of solutions (QM/MM-energy representation) based…

item.title: Orbitol: Crystal Generation on Wyckoff Orbits
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ivan Žugec, Joshua Rosenthal, Ivor Lončarić, Jan-Willem van de Meent, Tin Hadži Veljković
arXiv:2610.30086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models propose crystalline materials by learning composition and geometry, but unconditional sampling gives no direct control over the space group, which constrains whether responses such as piezoelectricity are symmetry-allowed. We present Orbitol, a crystal generator built on the Crystalite diffusion Transformer that replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens. Given a space group and a collection of occupied Wyckoff positions, Orbitol generates the atom type and free coordinates of each orbit together with a compatible lattice, so every valid structure is invariant under the operations of the requested group. It generates structures two to three orders of magnitude faster than the symmetry-aware baselines at the evaluated se…

item.title: The effect of electrocatalyst roughness and morphology on selectivity due to mass transport
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Mass transport can significantly affect electrocatalytic selectivity as surface-bound reaction intermediates are exchanged between the electrode and bulk electrolyte. The underlying desorption–re-adsorption–reaction mechanism allows an intermediate to escape the surface as a partially converted product or re-adsorb for continued conversion, but it is still not clear how the catalyst morphology affects this competition. Here, we focus on the role of the electrocatalyst surface morphology and its effective representation in transport-coupled kinetic models. Using CO selectivity during CO 2 reduction on copper as a model system, we compare predictions from a 1D diffusion model, where surface roughness serves as a single morphological descriptor, against a more advanced 3D diffusion model tha…

item.title: 金色纳米带的电子、结构和磁性特性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fabrício M. de Vasconcelos, Kleuton A. L. Lima, Paloma V. Silva, Eduardo C. Girão, Alexandre C. Dias, Douglas S. Galvão 等7位作者
最近，二维金（一种单原子层金片）已通过实验实现，有望成为下一代器件的有前途的材料，提供超越三维块状金的新可能性。由于准一维导数可以表现出与其二维对应物明显不同的特性，因此我们使用第一原理计算方法研究了金基纳米带（GOLDNR）的稳定性、电子和磁性。我们的研究结果表明，这些纳米带的电子结构强烈依赖于边缘手性和带宽度。根据边界配置，系统可以表现出电子带隙约为 0.77 eV 和 0.04 eV 的半导体行为，或保留金属特性。

item.title: 表征空间嵌入之外的通用拓扑相位
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sunkyu Yu, Xianji Piao, Namkyoo Park
尽管汉密尔顿定律支配波-物质相互作用，但物质拓扑相位的传统表征需要的不仅仅是汉密尔顿定律，它依赖于在闭逆空间流形上定义的全局不变量或与位置算子的局部换向关系。这种空间依赖性排除了在抽象平台上对拓扑相位的独特表征，其哈密顿量可以独立于其空间嵌入进行定义。在这里，我们建立了一个表征通用拓扑相位的框架，其基础是任意汉密尔顿保留变形下拓扑特征的不变性。我们构造了一个基于汉密尔顿的空间嵌入，根据系统的连通性对系统的成分进行分组。

item.title: Charge Density Wave transient states induced by ultrashort hard X-ray pulses
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 D. Ghoneim, E. Bellec, L. Ortega, V. L. R. Jacques, A. A Sinchenko, P. Wzietek 等15位作者
arXiv:2610.29860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interaction of quantum systems with ultrashort laser pulses may lead to transient states far from equilibrium. Among these, Charge Density Wave (CDW) systems offer very rich non-equilibrium physics when submitted to ultrashort optical excitations in the infrared regime. In this Letter, we show that CDW systems pumped by ultrashort x-ray pulses excite the system in very different way. The x-ray pump, 6000 times more energetic than a laser pulse, pumping and probing the whole bulk system simultaneously, drives CDW systems in a novel reversible out of equilibrium state. The successive CDW states observed in the NbSe₃ system with respect to the arrival of x-ray pulses follow a non-thermal kinetic path. It is characterized by a change in 2k_F…

item.title: 从第一原理出发的时空自旋输运
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mayada Fadel, Joshua Quinton, Mani Chandra, Mayank Gupta, Aron W. Cummings, Yuan Ping 等7位作者
操纵量子信息和自旋电子器件的自旋需要对长时间和长度尺度上的量子输运进行定量预测。我们在维格纳函数形式中引入了第一原理密度矩阵量子输运的计算框架，该框架促进了自旋动力学和输运模拟，同时考虑了器件长度尺度上的电子声子散射。这使我们能够阐明现实的自旋轨道场（例如 Rashba 和持久自旋螺旋）对几种材料中相干自旋输运的影响，以及随着电子声子散射强度的增加而向非相干输运的转变。

The integration of strain further enhances their performance by modulating carrier mobility, band structure, and transport behavior without altering material chemistry. Within the NW, the silicon-silicon dioxide (Si-SiO₂) interface serves as a critical region where strain redistribution and suboxide bonding collectively influence the mechanical and electronic response. Here, we combine reactive force field molecular dynamics and first-principles calculations to investigate how oxidation-induced interfacial structure and crystallographic f…

item.title: Chiral-Nematic Lattice Instability in Charge Density Wave of 1T-TiSe2
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abdurrafi Ahsan Alghifari, Euihwan Do, Jae Whan Park, Han Woong Yeom
arXiv:2610.29448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral charge-density waves (CDWs) are a rare form of electronic order with handedness, enabling novel couplings among light, lattice, and topology in quantum materials. Yet the microscopic origin of chirality has remained elusive, even in the prototypical chiral CDW system 1T-TiSe2. Using ab initio calculations, we investigate the structural stability and electronic structure of competing CDW models in 1T-TiSe2. We show that a chiral monoclinic (C2) structure is stabilized by the cooperative condensation of multiple phonon modes and reproduces the chiral topography and energy gap observed experimentally. We further find an exceptionally soft potential landscape around this energy-minimized structure, along the direction that removes the rem…

item.title: 层伪自旋铁磁体的动态隧道阻塞
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lingxian Kong, Yuta Murakami, Ryuichi Shindou, Zhiyuan Sun
具有窄或扁平电子带的双层系统可以表现出由层-伪旋铁磁有序参数描述的自发层间相干性。在层伪自旋铁磁体的现代实现中，电子携带额外的谷退化，赋予每层谷伪自旋自由度。我们研究了在层间隧穿存在时由静态层间电压偏置驱动的非平衡稳态。在低偏压状态下，系统处于静态，两层之间有平行谷伪旋，我们表明，在高偏压状态下，层伪旋的动态进动稳定了反平行配置的谷伪旋，强烈抑制了层间隧穿。这种动态隧道阻塞导致没有交流电流，直流隧道电流急剧下降到很小的值，与传统的量子霍尔双层形成鲜明对比。

item.description:

👤 Haozhe Yang, Zhendong Chi, Eoin Dolan, Josep Ingla-Aynés, Beatriz Martín-García, Witold Skowroński 等10位作者
arXiv:2610.29739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-charge interconversion provides the essential link between spin information and electrical signals in spintronic devices. In spin-orbit coupled systems, spin-charge interconversion can contain multiple components associated with different spin-polarization directions, reflecting the underlying spin texture. Tuning this spin texture therefore provides a way to control not only the magnitude of spin-charge interconversion, but also the balance among its different components. Graphene-based van der Waals heterostructures provide an attractive platform for this purpose because interfacial spin-orbit coupling can host multiple spin-charge interconversion channels that couple to different spin-polarization directions. item.title: Generalized Coordinate Bethe Ansatz and Quantum Integrability of the Time-Dependent Massive Thirring Model
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Parameshwar R. Pasnoori
arXiv:2610.29998v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a generalized coordinate Bethe-ansatz framework for the massive Thirring model with an explicitly time-dependent fermion mass. Unlike the generalized Bethe ansatz for chiral quantum field theories, where particle transport acts in internal spin spaces and leads to quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations, the present construction acts directly on particle coordinates and physical rapidities. Its central new feature is a rapidity lattice. Because the time-dependent mass couples right- and left-moving components already in the one-particle sector, a fixed-rapidity block is not closed under spatial winding. item.title: 刘维尔不可逆对称性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ying-Cheng Yang, Jhen-Dong Lin, Yueh-Nan Chen
不可逆对称性将传统对称性扩展到类群变换之外，并在量子场论和多体物理学中发挥着重要作用。然而，开放量子系统中不可逆对称性的通用框架仍然缺乏。在这里，我们制定了一个通用的刘维尔空间对偶框架，将希尔伯特空间不可逆对偶性扩展到开放量子系统。由此产生的缺陷将刘维尔方程与对偶哈密顿量和耗散参数联系起来，并成为自对偶性的精确对称性。我们将此框架应用于周期性横向场伊辛链，该链具有由克莱默斯-万尼尔（KW）对偶性交换的两个集体 Lindblad 通道。

item.title: Microscopic origin of field-induced multiferroicity in Ni3TeO6
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 J. Lass, R. Toft-Petersen, A. A. Turrini, Ø. S. Fjellvåg, B. Decrausaz, K. M. L. Krighaar 等18位作者
arXiv:2610.29420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continued demand for smaller, faster, and more energy-efficient technologies has driven condensed-matter research towards materials combining multiple responses within a single phase. Particularly interesting examples are multiferroic materials featuring cross-couplings between order parameters. Ni3TeO6 is a prominent member of this material class, exhibiting a hysteresis-free transition under magnetic field which simultaneously affects the magnetic structure, electric polarization, and phonon frequencies. Here, we uncover the microscopic origin of this multiferroic transition using a combination of neutron scattering techniques. item.title: Perpendicular Magnetization from Crystallite Boundaries in Polycrystalline Antiferromagnetic γ-FeMn
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rachel E. Maizel, Sachli Abdizadeh, Ali Almahmoud, Omolara A. Bakare, Galen T. Street, Hanu Arava 等23位作者

item.title: 识别拓扑半金属中缺陷不敏感电子传输的框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lily Jade Joyce, Michelle M. Kelley, Timothy Philicelli, Ching-tzu Chen, Ravishankar Sundararaman
拓扑半金属在未来半导体芯片中替代传统金属互连的兴趣日益浓厚，因为它们有可能随着导线尺寸的减小而表现出电阻率降低的潜力，并且对缺陷处的电子散射具有较低的敏感性。对用于互连的有前途的拓扑半金属的第一性原理评估通常采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术来估计缺陷散射，但这种针对特定缺陷几何形状的计算很难系统化并在不同材料之间进行比较。在这里，我们开发了一种基于 NEGF 的方法，可以系统、快速地评估材料中电子传输的缺陷敏感性，而不依赖于材料特定的缺陷几何形状。

item.title: 从行波到合成规范场：超导二极管效应的无场途径
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Latu Kalita, Koustav Roy, Bilal Tanatar, Saurabh Basu
超导二极管效应要求正向和反向偏置电流不同，这是通过反转和时间反转对称性一起破坏来实现的情况。后者，也是更重要的一个，不可避免地要通过磁场来实现。在这里，我们证明了时空驱动的化学势 μⱼ(t)=μ+Vcos(ω t+kd j) 形式可以同时实现这两个目标。应用于螺旋柴犬链时，该驱动器通过生成奇数动量项来转变行进的 Peierls 相位，相当于真实空间中想象的次近邻 Haldane 式跳跃。值得注意的是，该协议是自旋盲的，它通过合成规范通量而不是有效的塞曼场来实现时间反转破坏。

item.title: Intertwined complex orbital order and ferrimagnetism in honeycomb molybdate Fe₂Mo₃O₈
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hong-Hao Song, Gang v. Chen
arXiv:2610.29729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent experimental interest in honeycomb molybdates A₂Mo₃O₈, we return and develop the minimal models to capture the essential physics for Fe₂Mo₃O₈. It is pointed out that, the magnetism in these materials arises from the mutual induction between the spin-orbit coupling of the tetrahedral sublattice with active orbitals and the superexchange with the spins from the octahedral sublattice. Essentially, the superexchange between the tetrahedral and octahedral sublattices directly drives the ferrimagnetism, and the residual spin-orbit coupling on the tetrahedral sublattice induces the complex orbital order. item.title: NbSe2-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x与NbSe2-Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y对称不匹配范德华混合结中的Josephson效应

不同对称性的耦合超导体可能导致出现量子现象，但由晶格不匹配的晶体组成的异质结的实验研究很少。在这里，我们通过在Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x或Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y的新鲜裂解表面上堆叠NbSe2薄片来制造Josephson结。我们在低于7 K的温度下获得跨异质结的显著约瑟夫森电流。

arXiv:2610.29463v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) usually relies on magnetic ordering, which fixes a preferred moment orientation and couples it to charge transport.
